name: bhr-cooperate
idea_origin: Matteo (27 Oct): bhr-countdown failed (first review 2/8 vs BHR 4/8): Haiku wrote the countdown and option marks but mis-marked costs. In the month-5 choices of the BHR and bhr-countdown games, every Network loss came from distancing options (refuse, stay quiet, stick to own work, write only own part, firm rebuke, set out who owned what, harsh fair grade); the one Output loss from postponing own work.
operator: targeted revision of bhr (replaces bhr-countdown, deleted)
hypothesis: Keeping the countdown switch but replacing the hidden-cost checklist with a visible-feature rule (engage with the person, never distance; do not postpone own work) cuts Network losses in the month before a review and raises first-review promotion above BHR's 4/8.
change: BHR plus: 'Review in N' at the start of every note; for N = 1 only, choose options that engage with people and keep them on side, never distancing ones; do not postpone own deliverable; honesty limits; Health guard. Manifest instruction filled in.
predicted_behaviour: In N = 1 months notes name the engaging option; Network at the first review mostly at its ceiling; first-review promotion at least 6/8; no blackouts.
refutation: 8 Haiku games with actor 017798b931bc18f8, stopped after the first review unless promising. Reject if first-review promotion is not above 4/8 or blackouts or trust crises rise.
notes: Branch matteo/main. Inline in SKILL.md. bhr-countdown removed from the repo; its games stay in the registry (policy f1519df2f6601d3f).
